## Judgment

### Expected-drift set

All six evaluable configs. Every one gains the `herdr` package and
`~/.config/herdr/config.toml`; the five carrying `user-terminal-home`
(sweet16, petunia, hermes, dualie, forge) additionally get a changed
`tmux.conf`. `groot@rk3588` is N/A on this arch as usual.

`fc2af6a` — the previous sign-off's own commit — was verified drift-free
against `7bd67f5` first, so the whole table is attributable to the three
commits in this range and nothing else.

### Actual vs expected

Match. Content of the drift was checked directly rather than inferred:
diffing `home.packages` and `xdg.configFile` between `fc2af6a` and `HEAD`
for `groot@forge`, `ddukes@avina` and `ddukes@sweet16` shows exactly one
added package (`herdr-0.7.5`) and one added config key
(`herdr/config.toml`) per config. Nothing removed, nothing else added.

The generated `tmux.conf` was diffed store-path to store-path. The delta is
four new `bind H/J/K/L swap-pane` lines and the two `unbind` lines moving
after the generated block. Every other byte — status bar, clipboard/OSC 52,
`WheelUpPane`, the `copy-mode-vi` bindings — is unchanged, including the
two-space column alignment on `bind -n S-Left  previous-window`, which the
renderer reproduces. The swap-pane bindings are a deliberate addition, not
incidental drift: they are the tmux half of the shared keymap.

### Why this is not a structural refactor

`lib/keymap.nix` moves tmux's bindings from literal text to generated text,
which normally implies zero drift. It does not here, and should not: the
point of the change is that tmux and herdr resolve bindings from one
source, and reaching that state adds the four bindings tmux was missing.

### Correctness evidence beyond evaluation

The herdr config is gated at build time by `herdr config check`, which is
hermetic and exits 1 on any unknown key or invalid binding — so the
generated `[keys]` table and the stylix-derived `[theme.custom]` tokens are
verified by the binary itself, not by inspection. This is load-bearing:
herdr.dev's documentation is ahead of 0.7.5 and lists keys
(`move_tab_next`, `resize_pane_*`) and theme tokens (`sidebar_bg`,
`active_row_bg`, `selection_bg`) that 0.7.5 rejects.

The Claude Code hook was exercised end to end against a stub socket under
`env -i`: it emits a well-formed `pane.report_agent_session` JSON-RPC
request. The `settings.json` merge was run three times over a file
containing unrelated user keys and a pre-existing `SessionStart` hook —
idempotent, one herdr entry, nothing else touched.

`herdr` for `aarch64-linux` is present in cache.nixos.org (narinfo 200), so
rk3588 will substitute rather than build Rust on the SBC.

### Deploy note

No host has been deployed. sweet16 is the local desktop; the tmux change
only affects newly started servers, and herdr is additive.
